claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a branded Mango wall-mounted heat/massage-style device with a front control panel and an outward hood/arm on a stand/wall mount.
Photos do not show usage duration or service history.
Photos show the unit but do not clearly confirm absence of faults, internal issues, or fine cosmetic defects (scratches/dents/wear at joints/cables).

risks.risk: It may not power on or may not heat/operate correctly (heating element or control failure).
risks.proof: A short function test video: plug in, power on, show heat increasing/working indicator, and demonstrate controls responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/possibly not working until a live power-on and heating demonstration is provided.

risks.risk: Internal faults (motor/thermostat/wiring) or intermittent operation not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A clip showing stable operation for several minutes plus any error lights/abnormal sounds; ideally include a quick open-box inspection photo of wiring/heating element (if safe).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for electrical appliances: treat as needing inspection/repair risk.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or power cable/incorrect power setup (voltage compatibility, fuse/overheat protection).
risks.proof: Photos of the label/spec plate (voltage/wattage) and what exact power cable/plug is included; show the unit connected to the correct outlet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/uncertain compatibility until the exact power requirements and included cable are confirmed.

risks.risk: Cosmetic or structural wear at the hood/arm joints, stand mount, or cable entry that affects usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the hood/arm joints, mounting points, and any cable/cord entry points; include a side-angle showing wear clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition if fine wear cannot be ruled out.

proof_requests: Send a live video showing power-on and heating/operation (controls working) for at least a few minutes.
Send clear close-up photos of the spec/ratings label (voltage/wattage) and any safety markings (fuse/overheat protection).
Confirm and show what power cable/plug is included (or whether it’s hardwired) with a photo of the connection point.
Send close-ups of the hood/arm joints and mounting/stand points to confirm no looseness or cracks.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies a Mango wall-mounted heat device with a front control panel, so it can be priced at worst-case for untested electrical function. Seller claims about usage time and perfect condition are not verifiable from photos, so the price should reflect that uncertainty.
